responses.notes: We should consider how we map or relate personality and emotional state to pacing, filler words, expletives, critical thinking, tension that emphasizes anxiousness and emotion and communication, thought- behavior itself, adaption and environmental modeling of goal-object orientation in the world relative to others. This is not necessarily suggesting create something new, maybe somewhat, but it is mostly asking to maximize what currently exists and how granularly we emphasize the presence of realistic distinction and adaptability that we train into small models per variable.
